title: fix(app-shell): the page designer stops offering the retired page:header breadcrumb toggle (objectui#11173)
body:
Fixes #11173
Clause-②: no

The Studio page designer stops offering the "Show breadcrumb" toggle on the canonical `page:header` block. `breadcrumb` leaves `BLOCK_CONFIG['page:header']`, and its label key `engine.inspector.pageBlock.field.page:header.breadcrumb` leaves both the en and zh tables of the designer's i18n file. This is the shape the header's `icon` field took. The field-set pin and the label pin move with it.

Why: the canonical `page:header` renderer already ignores the key (objectui#11166, landed as PR objectui#11172), and objectstack#20758 retires `PageHeaderProps.breadcrumb` in the spec through ADR-0087. Until then the toggle authors a key nothing reads. Once objectui pins a spec release carrying that tombstone, the platform refuses the key by name. The producer leaves first, so the pin bump does not find it standing.

Implemented by the dispatched os-dev of `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, branch `claude/issue-11173-retire-breadcrumb-toggle`.

## Stored pages: no strip (triage ruling on the card)

A page that already carries `breadcrumb` is not rewritten by the designer. It opens, the key shows under Advanced by its raw name (a checkbox, still checked), and the next save keeps it. `RETIRED_BLOCK_PROP_KEYS` deliberately gains no `page:header` entry: the spec's ADR-0087 conversion strips the key on load, with its notice, and a second strip in the designer would be a second mechanism that hides that notice. A new screen-level control pins this, and an ablation shows it can fail (below).

## Changes, all in the `page:header` region

- `previews/block-config.ts`: the `breadcrumb` entry leaves `BLOCK_CONFIG['page:header']`. A comment beside the existing `icon` note says why, and why the strip table stays untouched.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the en row ("Show breadcrumb") and the zh row of `engine.inspector.pageBlock.field.page:header.breadcrumb` are removed, with a one-line note beside each `icon` note.
- `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts`: the header field-set pin is now `['title', 'subtitle']`. A new describe, "page:header `breadcrumb` — the designer toggle retired with its reader", pins that the toggle is not offered and that neither locale keeps a translation for it.
- `inspectors/PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx`: the zh-CN label pair for the toggle leaves the "one language" case. Its absence is now pinned in the new file.
- `inspectors/PageBlockInspector.pageHeaderBreadcrumb-11173.test.tsx` (new): screen pins. In en-US and zh-CN, the panel offers Title and Subtitle, has no checkbox, and shows no label or raw key for the toggle. A stored `breadcrumb: true` opens, visible and checked under Advanced, and an edit to Title commits `{ title: 'Customer', breadcrumb: true }`, which is the control.
- `.changeset/11173-retire-page-header-breadcrumb-toggle.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Verification (at `1d8257ab5`, the branch head)

- Target tests: `pnpm exec vitest run` over `block-config.test.ts`, `block-config-i18n.test.ts`, `PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx`, `PageBlockInspector.retiredBlockProps.test.tsx` and the new file gives **5 files, 98 passed**. At BASE `846cec0ef` the first four gave 4 files, 92 passed, so the change adds +2 in `block-config.test.ts` and +4 in the new file. A verbose run lists all six new cases by name.
- Ablation 1, put the toggle back. `ablation-replace` planted the entry back into `BLOCK_CONFIG['page:header']` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `73518960b48b` to `ebc2ef0c43c7`). Result: **3 files failed, 9 failed / 61 passed**. The failures include the field-set pin ("still offers the canonical header fields the renderer does implement"), "does NOT offer the retired `breadcrumb` toggle", `block-config-i18n.test.ts`'s "every key resolves in en-US" / "in zh-CN", "zh-CN is actually translated", "the extractor really sees the keys the derivation implies", and three of the four new screen cases. The restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD `73518960b48b`, `git diff HEAD` on the path empty. The restore leg ran 3 files, 70 passed. A first attempt was a no-op: its replacement contained its anchor, so the tool refused (anchor 1 to 1) before running any test. It was re-run with a non-overlapping anchor.
- Ablation 2, add the strip the ruling forbids. Planting `'page:header': ['breadcrumb']` into `RETIRED_BLOCK_PROP_KEYS` gave **2 files failed, 3 failed / 67 passed**: both stored-page control cases ("opens" and "saves") and the existing "every registered key really is one the block schema refuses BY NAME". The restore was proven the same way, and the restore leg passed 70 of 70.
- Both ablations mutate source that the tests import by relative path (`../block-config`, `../previews/block-config.js`), not through a package `exports`/`dist`, so no rebuild hop applies.
- Lock-free gates, all exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ("5 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check:i18n-keys`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, and `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit`. A raw control-byte self-scan of the changed files found no hits.
- `check:changeset-claims` listed six pending changesets that name a file this diff touches. Each paragraph was read, and none makes a claim about the `page:header` breadcrumb toggle or its field set.
- ESLint, narrowed to the changed files: `pnpm exec eslint` on the 5 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--format json` counts 5 files) gives 0 errors and 2 warnings. Both warnings are `no-explicit-any` in `block-config.test.ts`, and BASE's copy of that file carries the same 2. Population: the root `eslint.config.js` (`**/*.{ts,tsx}`) that each package's `lint` (`eslint .`) runs. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no local rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- Root `scripts/__tests__`, narrowed because the diff adds a markdown changeset: I ran the 38 test files there that mention `changeset` (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, lock-free) and got **38 files, 1433 passed**. The whole suite was not run locally.
- **NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI:** the `@object-ui/app-shell` dependency-closure build (29 packages) and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`. Reason: the shared verify lock was held for more than 49 minutes by one run (issue-11196's `verify-all.sh`, pid 14872, alive and busy), with three waiters ahead. This branch spent about an hour queued across five tries without getting the lock for this half. CI's `Type Check` job runs both `tsc` projects, and CI's test job runs the full `scripts/__tests__` suite.

## Overlap with PR objectui#10278

PR objectui#10278 edits `block-config.ts`, `block-config.test.ts`, `block-config-i18n.test.ts` and `PageBlockInspector.retiredBlockProps.test.tsx` in the `object-kanban` region only. This PR touches the `page:header` region of `block-config.ts` and `block-config.test.ts`, and does not touch the other two files. The hunks are disjoint.

## Acceptance notes

- A stored `breadcrumb` stays editable under Advanced, which can set a value but has no delete. That follows from the no-strip ruling. The spec's ADR-0087 conversion removes it on load once objectui pins that release.
- For the seat that bumps the `@objectstack/spec` pin to a release carrying objectstack#20758's tombstone:
  - `RETIRED_BLOCK_PROP_KEYS` membership criterion 2 ("the node schema refuses the key BY NAME") would then admit `breadcrumb`, and the existing "every registered key really is one the block schema refuses BY NAME" pin would stop objecting. The new round-trip control is what keeps the ruling.
  - The `icon` describe's tombstone probe (`isShapeKeyTombstoned(PageHeaderProps, …)`) is the pattern for a breadcrumb tombstone assertion.
- The `page:header` component registration in `@object-ui/components` still declares a `breadcrumb` input described as "Ignored … Leave it out." That was PR objectui#11172's deliberate choice while the contract accepts the key. It is not this card's surface.
- Known external red: the required `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on every objectui PR against objectstack main (anchor card objectui#11206). It is not caused by this diff and is not touched here.
